summary: Learn to review tourism suppliers, itineraries and visitor impacts using GSTC Criteria. Build practical safeguards and an action plan. Explore the course.
lede: Socially responsible tourism considers how travel products and visitor practices affect workers, communities and natural assets. For tour operations staff, destination practitioners and tourism product designers, this training supports itinerary and supplier reviews through supply-chain mapping, supplier screening, visitor-pressure assessment and guest-claim checks, using the GSTC Criteria and the UN Tourism Global Code of Ethics for Tourism as reference points.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who make or influence tourism product, supplier, visitor and destination decisions. It suits people building a foundation in ethical tourism practice and responsible-travel operations.
modules: Tourism Ethics and the UN Tourism Code
Tourism Supply Chains and Local Benefit
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with tourism services, travel operations or visitor-facing work is useful. You do not need prior sustainability or compliance training.
